abstract: In short, the comparison of the arms gives these main findings. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same side effects. Overall, Cardivel lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same side effects. Overall, Cardivel lowers systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Maplewood Cardiac Group.
